{"dos":["Always use Midnight Ink (#0f1011) as the primary page background to maintain the dark theme.","Utilize Lyondisplay App weight 300 for prominent headlines, letting its lightness convey subtle authority.","Apply a generous 16px border-radius to static cards and 8px to interactive components like buttons and inputs.","Structure primary buttons as Ghost White text on a transparent background, accented with a light border, to maintain visual lightness.","Incorporate accent colors like Ocean Glimmer (#00b3dd) or Violet Haze (#847dff) primarily within card backgrounds or data visualizations, as functional highlights.","Maintain comfortable element spacing with 12px as a common `elementGap` between related items.","Ensure all body text uses Suisseintl weight 400 for optimal readability on dark backgrounds."],"donts":["Avoid using harsh, saturated primary colors for large background areas; reserve vivid hues for contained accents.","Do not introduce strong drop shadows; the system relies on distinct background colors and subtle borders for elevation.","Do not deviate from the specified font families or their intended weights and letter spacing, as these are critical for brand identity.","Never use Ghost White (#ffffff) text directly on Slate Canvas (#000000) for large text blocks; primary text should sit against Midnight Ink or Elevated Charcoal for optimal contrast.","Avoid using generic button styles; always apply the specific radius (8px or 1440px) as defined for primary actions.","Do not create dense layouts; maintain a comfortable density with ample padding and vertical spacing.","Don't use more than a single accent color in any given visual area to avoid visual clutter and maintain focus."],"theme":"dark","colors":[{"hex":"#0f1011","name":"Midnight Ink","role":"Primary page and large section background; Complex background gradient for hero sections, adding atmospheric depth","group":"neutral","gradient":"linear-gradient(rgb(15, 16, 17), rgb(19, 29, 39) 18%, rgb(26, 71, 136) 37%, rgb(64, 138, 193) 69%, rgb(64, 138, 193) 102%)"},{"hex":"#2e2e2e","name":"Elevated Charcoal","role":"Card backgrounds, secondary container surfaces","group":"neutral"},{"hex":"#000000","name":"Slate Canvas","role":"Neutral form states, badge text, and quiet UI feedback where color should stay understated. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color","group":"neutral"},{"hex":"#ffffff","name":"Ghost White","role":"Primary text, button text on dark backgrounds, active states, borders","group":"neutral"},{"hex":"#f5f5f7","name":"Faded Mist","role":"Secondary text for headlines, subtle borders","group":"neutral"},{"hex":"#cacaca","name":"Subtle Ash","role":"Tertiary text, divider lines, muted elements","group":"neutral"},{"hex":"#6a6b6b","name":"Whisper Blue","role":"Placeholder text, minor descriptive text, inactive button borders","group":"neutral"},{"hex":"#00b3dd","name":"Ocean Glimmer","role":"Decorative card backgrounds, accent in data visualizations","group":"accent"},{"hex":"#847dff","name":"Violet Haze","role":"Decorative card backgrounds, accent in data visualizations, icon fills","group":"accent"},{"hex":"#d1c9ff","name":"Lavender Mist","role":"Muted decorative card backgrounds, secondary accent","group":"accent"},{"hex":"#dd90d8","name":"Soft Rose","role":"Decorative card backgrounds, accent for specific data points","group":"accent"},{"hex":"#4b49aa","name":"Deep Indigo","role":"Stronger decorative card backgrounds, prominent accent","group":"accent"},{"hex":"#90b8f0","name":"Sky Tint","role":"Light decorative card backgrounds, tertiary accent","group":"accent"},{"hex":"#195f97","name":"Deep Sea","role":"Subtle blue tint for borders and muted text, often in navigation","group":"accent"},{"hex":"#2b2b2c","name":"Dark Sky Gradient","role":"Background gradient for hero sections, conveying depth and atmosphere","group":"neutral","gradient":"linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(43, 43, 44), rgb(19, 19, 19))"}],"layout":"The page uses a max-width 1200px centered layout for content sections. The hero section is full-bleed, featuring atmospheric photography or gradient backgrounds with a large, centered headline and a centered call-to-action block. Subsequent sections maintain consistent vertical spacing, creating a comfortable, unhurried rhythm. Content is often presented in centered stacks or a 3-column card grid, with cards dynamically themed. Navigation is a sticky top bar, minimal and semi-transparent, supporting a secondary Log In button and a prominent 'Get Started' ghost button. The layout feels spacious and deliberate, with breathing room between major content blocks.","imagery":"The site primarily uses dark, atmospheric photography as background elements in hero sections, often with cloud formations, setting a reflective and expansive mood. Product screenshots are contained within device mockups (like iPhones), showcasing the UI in a dark mode context, implying functionality and data visualization. Illustrations are absent. Icons are minimal, monochromatic, and outlined, reinforcing the clean, data-focused UI. Imagery serves as decorative atmosphere or explanatory product showcase, not content-heavy. The overall density is text-dominant.","spacing":{"radius":{"cards":"16px","buttons":"8px","largeCards":"30px","pillButtons":"1440px","circularElements":"14385.6px"},"density":"comfortable","baseUnit":4,"elementGap":"12px","sectionGap":"64px","cardPadding":"32px","pageMaxWidth":"1200px"},"industry":"fintech","surfaces":[{"hex":"#0f1011","name":"Midnight Ink Canvas","level":0,"purpose":"Primary base background for the entire application, providing a deep, consistent dark theme."},{"hex":"#2e2e2","name":"Elevated Charcoal Card","level":1,"purpose":"Background for cards and secondary content blocks, slightly elevating them from the base canvas without heavy shadows."},{"hex":"#000000","name":"Slate Canvas Input","level":2,"purpose":"Used for interactive elements like input fields and some button backgrounds, providing a distinct contrast for usability against deeper neutrals."}],"northStar":"Midnight Command Center – screens glowing with data against a dark, seamless backdrop.","typeScale":[{"role":"caption","size":11,"lineHeight":1.5,"letterSpacing":0.182},{"role":"body","size":14,"lineHeight":1.5},{"role":"heading","size":38,"lineHeight":1},{"role":"heading-lg","size":80,"lineHeight":0.9},{"role":"display","size":96,"lineHeight":0.9}],"components":[{"name":"Primary Ghost Button","role":"Main call to action on dark backgrounds.","description":"Ghost White text on a transparent background with an 8px radius. Text is 16px Suisseintltrial weight 400. Hover state shows a subtle white background fill. Padding: 12px vertical, 18px horizontal."},{"name":"Light Filled Button","role":"Call to action on dark backgrounds where immediate strong contrast is needed.","description":"Slate Canvas text on a Ghost White background with an 8px radius. Text is 16px Suisseintltrial weight 400. Padding: 12px vertical, 18px horizontal."},{"name":"Circular Micro Button","role":"Small, interactive buttons for secondary actions or toggles.","description":"Ghost White text on a transparent background with a 100% border radius (effectively circular). Background is rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2). Padding: 1px vertical, 6px horizontal."},{"name":"Pill Input Field","role":"Search bars or prominent single-line text inputs.","description":"Slate Canvas background with a 1440px border-radius (pill shape). Ghost White text color at 16px Suisseintl weight 400. Left padding 32px, right padding 10px. Subtle border rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)."},{"name":"Themed Content Card","role":"Displaying data or information with a unique thematic background color.","description":"Features a large 16px border-radius. Background colors vary, often utilizing Ocean Glimmer, Violet Haze, or Soft Rose. No box shadow, relying instead on distinct background color for separation. Padding: 90px."},{"name":"Seamless Card","role":"Cards seamlessly integrated into the background with no discernible borders or shadows.","description":"No border radius, no box shadow, transparent background. Typically used for internal content organization or when imagery fills the card area."},{"name":"Floating Data Card","role":"Elevated card for statistical data or features, used against a dark background.","description":"Elevated Charcoal background with a 30px border radius. Padding: 32px. No box shadow, distinct color defines elevation."}],"typography":[{"role":"Display headlines and hero titles. The 300 weight is used for large, elegant branding, conveying authority through visual lightness instead of heavy impact.","sizes":"38px, 80px, 96px","family":"Lyondisplay App","source":"custom","weight":"300, 400","lineHeight":"0.90, 1.00","substitute":"Playfair Display, Lora"},{"role":"Navigation, interactive elements, and certain card labels. Its slightly wider tracking gives it an airy, modern feel, especially at smaller sizes.","sizes":"11px, 14px, 16px","family":"Suisseintltrial","source":"custom","weight":"400","lineHeight":"1.00, 1.50, 1.67, 2.18","substitute":"Montserrat, Lato","letterSpacing":"0.182em"},{"role":"Body text, subheadings, and general UI text. Its normal letter spacing ensures readability for longer blocks of text.","sizes":"12px, 14px, 16px, 18px","family":"Suisseintl","source":"custom","weight":"300, 400","lineHeight":"1.00, 1.41, 1.43, 1.50, 2.00","substitute":"Inter, Roboto","letterSpacing":"normal"},{"role":"Used for code snippets, financial figures, and technical data where fixed-width alignment and precise character distinction are important.","sizes":"10px, 11px, 12px, 16px","family":"Roboto Mono","source":"google","weight":"400, 500","lineHeight":"1.35, 1.40, 1.50, 2.00","substitute":"Space Mono, Fira Code","letterSpacing":"0.016em, 0.021em, 0.182em"}],"description":"Origin Financial employs a 'Dark Canvas, Subtle Glow' visual system. It uses a deep, rich dark grey as its primary background, accented by layers of lighter, desaturated greys for elevated surfaces and text. Typography is elegant, with a focus on restrained display fonts and highly legible body text. While largely monochromatic, the system introduces a spectrum of soft, vivid colors within functional cards, creating a sense of dynamic data visualization and subtle branding rather than overt color blocking.","customSections":[{"title":"Agent Prompt Guide","content":"Quick Color Reference:
text: #ffffff
background: #0f1011
border: #ffffff
accent: #847dff
primary action: #ffffff (filled action)

Example Component Prompts:

1. Create a Primary Action Button: #ffffff background, #000000 text, 9999px radius, compact pill padding. Use this filled treatment for the main CTA.

2. Create a Themed Content Card: Use 'Ocean Glimmer' (#00b3dd) for the background with 16px border-radius. Inside, place a title 'Spending Overview' using Suisseintl weight 400, 18px, Ghost White text, and body text 'View your monthly budget' using Suisseintl weight 400, 14px, Ghost White text.

3. Create a Pill Input Field: Use Slate Canvas (#000000) background with 1440px border-radius. Placeholder text 'How have tariffs imp' in Whisper Blue (#6a6b6b) with Suisseintl weight 400, 16px. Left padding 32px, right padding 10px. Include a small circular submit button on the right with Ghost White icon, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2) background, 100% radius, 1px vertical 6px horizontal padding."}],"title":"Origin Financial"}

{"pagination":{"count":10,"page":1,"next_page":2,"total_count":1000,"total_pages":100},"records":[{"platform":"desktop","title":"Steep","url":"https://steep.app","uuid":"0a436b49-8740-4675-afa0-3563b092d555","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/steep.app/0a436b49-8740-4675-afa0-3563b092d555/preview_0.jpg","description":"A warm, airy analytics and AI product aesthetic built on a bright white canvas with soft blush gradients and subtle depth. The design feels crisp, calm, and editorial, balancing a premium serif headline treatment with a clean, compact sans-serif interface for a confident, modern SaaS presence. Large display typography has a refined, high-contrast look, while the supporting UI stays minimal and highly legible. Navigation is sparse and polished, with small pill-shaped actions in deep ink black. The layout is spacious and centered, using generous margins, rounded cards, and soft shadows to create a floating, layered feel. Content is organized into clean dashboard-like panels and data cards with light borders, gentle tints of fog and warm mist, and restrained accent colors in terracotta and muted blue-gray. Charts, metric blocks, and interface mockups are presented inside rounded containers, giving the page an image-rich but controlled composition. Overall it reads as elegant, confident, and softly luminous, with a measured balance of editorial sophistication and product clarity."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Modern Business Intelligence","url":"https://mode.com","uuid":"980966ef-e661-439d-8858-4cefe1e0451a","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/mode.com/980966ef-e661-439d-8858-4cefe1e0451a/preview_0.jpg","description":"A dark, editorial fintech landing-page aesthetic built around a deep forest-green canvas and vivid chartreuse highlight blocks. The overall feel is bold, confident, and highly branded, with a strong sense of contrast between the moody background and the bright lime-green headline containers that visually snap forward from the surface. Typography is large, blocky, and theatrical, using a serif display style for hero messaging that feels architectural and substantial, paired with smaller, clean sans-serif supporting text for navigation and body copy. The layout is spacious but tightly orchestrated, with left-aligned stacking, oversized hero typography, and a clear hierarchy that reads like a polished data lab or business-intelligence showcase. Rounded rectangles and soft 16px corners give the interface a friendly, modern polish, while the absence of shadows keeps everything feeling flat, crisp, and deliberately solid. Buttons and utility controls sit on pale paper-white surfaces or outlined dark treatments, creating a restrained but high-contrast navigation system. The imagery adds a human, collaborative layer with warm photographic scenes inside the otherwise graphic composition, reinforcing the blend of analytical precision and approachable enterprise style. Overall it feels premium, contemporary, and slightly experimental, with a vibrant neon-on-forest color story and a poster-like compositional rhythm."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Glassnode","url":"https://glassnode.com","uuid":"8e14f3d6-c248-4a13-9c42-577457d2920b","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/glassnode.com/8e14f3d6-c248-4a13-9c42-577457d2920b/preview_0.jpg","description":"Glassnode has a restrained, institutional analytical-console aesthetic with a strong dark-steel and off-white contrast. The visual language feels precise, serious, and data-first, using expansive charcoal sections, clean white panels, and very limited ultramarine-blue accents to signal interaction or chart emphasis. Typography is modern and highly readable, with large bold editorial-style hero headings, compact navigation, and dense but orderly body copy that creates a sense of confidence and clarity. Layouts are spacious and centered, with clear left-right composition, generous vertical separation, and a strong hierarchy that keeps the interface feeling calm even when content is information-rich. Cards and modules are rectangular and lightly bordered, with minimal rounding, subtle dividers, and little to no decorative flourish. Charts, line graphs, and product screenshots are the dominant visuals, framed like technical exhibits rather than marketing imagery, reinforcing a polished research-tool mood. Overall it balances corporate seriousness with a contemporary fintech/product-polish finish, relying on contrast, spacing, and disciplined accent color rather than ornamentation."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"PostHog","url":"https://posthog.com","uuid":"13bc10c0-3cf9-4feb-8bf8-bfdd123931fc","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/posthog.com/13bc10c0-3cf9-4feb-8bf8-bfdd123931fc/preview_0.jpg","description":"A playful, workshop-inspired light interface with a clean editorial SaaS feel. The overall canvas is warm and softly textured, using off-white and sand-toned backgrounds that make the central content window feel like a neatly placed sheet of paper on a workbench. Neutral whites, graphite grays, and charcoal typography create a calm, functional base, while bright Marigold Yellow buttons and Sky Blue highlights provide crisp focal points. The layout feels highly structured and desktop-native, with a top utility bar, icon-rich side navigation, and a centered application window framed like a workspace. Spacing is generous and orderly, with sharp or only slightly rounded corners, subtle borders, and very restrained shadows that keep the design grounded and precise. Typography is compact and engineered, with IBM Plex Sans giving the UI a bespoke technical personality through varied weights and tight headline spacing. Illustrations add the most distinctive character: charming hedgehog mascots and small hand-drawn scenes that feel whimsical yet purposeful, outlined in a flat, colorful style. The result is a product-design aesthetic that balances competent developer-tool clarity with approachable brand warmth, using a vivid gradient sparingly as a signature accent rather than a dominant surface treatment."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Operate","url":"https://operate.so","uuid":"a0f473eb-0310-4df5-b5f6-5bc124ad5954","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/operate.so/a0f473eb-0310-4df5-b5f6-5bc124ad5954/preview_0.jpg","description":"A highly structured, ledger-like SaaS landing page with a quiet artisanal feel. The screen is dominated by a pale cool-green canvas with a faint grid and fine ruled lines, giving it the look of a technical chart or archived record sheet. The hero visual is the main event: a dense, abstract data landscape made from scattered outlined circles, a flowing blue waveform band, and a trail of light markers, all floating inside the grid with an almost hand-plotted quality. Typography is compact and understated, with small meta labels and restrained navigation tucked into the edges, reinforcing the precise, document-like hierarchy. The palette stays tightly controlled: soft mint and sage surfaces, muted neutrals, deep green text accents, and a single violet button used as a surprising focal point. Borders are thin and inset, shadows are minimal, and surfaces feel flat yet tactile, like printed matter translated into a modern digital system. Overall it feels meticulous, calm, data-driven, and slightly experimental, with a strong emphasis on spacing, alignment, and visual rhythm rather than glossy polish."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Visitors","url":"https://visitors.now","uuid":"ba627291-3c39-4f94-823c-f161e8d2f729","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/visitors.now/ba627291-3c39-4f94-823c-f161e8d2f729/preview_0.jpg","description":"A bright, airy SaaS landing page with a crisp editorial feel and a playful analytical edge. The composition is centered and spacious, with a strong reliance on generous white space, compact text blocks, and clean horizontal alignment. Typography is bold and modern in the hero, paired with smaller, tightly tracked supporting copy that gives the interface a precise, data-minded tone. The color palette is restrained at the core—white, charcoal, and soft grays—then punctuated by a vivid violet brand accent used for the main CTA and selected pill controls. The upper navigation is presented as a dark rounded capsule, creating a striking contrast against the pale canvas, while the hero introduces a small badge, a large stacked headline, and two rounded buttons that feel soft and lightweight. Below, the design shifts into a more atmospheric section with a full-width purple-and-blue gradient backdrop, adding depth and energy without overwhelming the minimalist structure. Product imagery appears as clean, floating dashboard screenshots with subtle shadows, rounded containers, and sparse data visuals, reinforcing a polished analytics aesthetic. Supporting feature content is arranged in evenly spaced columns with thin line icons and concise copy, maintaining a calm, highly legible hierarchy. Overall, the style is polished, minimal, and slightly futuristic, blending enterprise clarity with a radiant, gradient-rich brand personality."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Uniswap Cup","url":"https://unicup.uniswap.org","uuid":"46156b44-5f16-42f5-8257-c921ba0385c5","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/unicup.uniswap.org/46156b44-5f16-42f5-8257-c921ba0385c5/preview_0.jpg","description":"A stark, high-contrast crypto tournament-bracket aesthetic on a white canvas, dominated by crisp black typography and a single electric fuchsia accent. The layout feels precise and data-driven, with a centered composition that opens into large bracket structures stretching to both sides. Visual hierarchy is built through compact score blocks, bracket lines, and small labeled tags, all rendered with sharp edges and almost no decorative softness. The typography is highly technical and clean, mixing bold monospace-style numerals with simple sans-serif labels for a digital, competitive feel. Fuchsia is used sparingly but decisively for match markers, connector lines, winner highlights, and key badges, creating energetic pops against the monochrome base. Cards and score tiles are minimal, flat, and tightly spaced, with a modular grid rhythm that makes the whole interface feel engineered rather than ornamental. Icons are small, symbolic, and functional, reinforcing the sense of a live bracket system or arena scoreboard with a polished, modern, almost editorial-technical finish."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Maze","url":"https://maze.co","uuid":"efaad2bb-9bac-4ac4-b838-807bd3d671ae","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/maze.co/efaad2bb-9bac-4ac4-b838-807bd3d671ae/preview_0.jpg","description":"A bright, editorial-style fintech SaaS aesthetic built around whiteboard clarity and restrained confidence. The interface uses a warm off-white canvas with crisp white cards, creating a light, airy workspace that feels spacious and highly legible. Typography is the main visual hero: oversized, thin-weight headlines in a modern grotesk style sit beside smaller neutral sans-serif body text, producing a sharp hierarchy with a refined, almost architectural feel. Navigation and controls are minimal and polished, with compact rounded buttons, subtle outlines, and plenty of breathing room. The color system is deliberately sparse and disciplined, relying on black and charcoal text, soft gray borders, and only a few vivid brand accents—lime for attention-grabbing highlights and forest green for links or understated functional emphasis. Cards and modules are flat, clean, and lightly rounded, with no heavy shadows, giving the layout a calm, uncluttered, product-forward presence. Occasional image tiles and preview panels introduce a slightly playful collage quality, but the overall impression remains professional, modern, and precise, like a thoughtfully designed research or analytics workspace with strong visual restraint."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Sandclock","url":"https://www.sandclock.org","uuid":"100771a2-1060-453d-b570-f2b1e33d6016","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/www.sandclock.org/100771a2-1060-453d-b570-f2b1e33d6016/preview_0.jpg","description":"A dark, high-contrast fintech aesthetic with a polished midnight-command-center feel. The interface sits on a near-black canvas with subtle tonal elevation rather than visible shadows, creating a quiet, immersive atmosphere. Typography is the dominant visual force: oversized, tightly tracked white headlines feel authoritative and modern, while supporting copy is compact, airy, and restrained. A single digital-green accent cuts through the darkness for primary actions, active states, and key metrics, giving the design a precise, signal-like energy. Layout is spacious and disciplined, with a centered hero, strong horizontal separators, and clean modular sections that alternate between wide logo strips, metric panels, and card grids. Cards are rectangular with soft rounding and minimal decoration, relying on surface contrast and thin borders for structure. Buttons are crisp and simple, with the green primary button acting as the focal point against the black background. Iconography is monochrome and functional, and the few visual graphics that appear are subtle, abstract, and secondary to the data-first presentation. Overall it feels serious, premium, and tightly controlled, with a sleek crypto/fintech command-desk polish."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Altitude","url":"https://www.altitude.so","uuid":"a4f48f30-01d8-49ce-ada6-068cf509e311","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/www.altitude.so/a4f48f30-01d8-49ce-ada6-068cf509e311/preview_0.jpg","description":"Altitude has a refined dark fintech aesthetic that feels like a midnight command center or premium trading terminal. The interface is built on a deep charcoal canvas with strong contrast from soft cloud-white cards and crisp ghost-white typography, creating a disciplined, low-noise visual system. A classic serif headline treatment gives the brand an authoritative editorial tone, while the supporting sans-serif text keeps the layout clear and modern. The hero composition is spacious and centered, with large elegant typography, restrained CTA styling, and a subtle mountain-line motif that adds atmosphere without competing for attention. Throughout the page, content is organized into generous, balanced sections with a mix of full-bleed dark panels and bright elevated modules, producing a deliberate rhythm between intensity and relief. Product mockups are presented inside sleek macOS-like frames, reinforcing a polished software showcase feel, while minimal monochrome icons, fine borders, and diffused shadows add precision and depth. Overall, the design is sophisticated, controlled, and highly premium, with an understated cinematic quality that suits an AI-first finance brand."}]}

{"pagination":{"count":10,"page":1,"next_page":2,"total_count":1000,"total_pages":100},"records":[{"platform":"desktop","title":"Ventriloc","url":"https://ventriloc.ca/en","uuid":"77a39d79-9e24-4440-8511-2853839d74ec","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/ventriloc.ca/77a39d79-9e24-4440-8511-2853839d74ec/preview_0.jpg","description":"Ventriloc has a crisp analytical-architecture look with a light, airy canvas and a very restrained warm-accent system. The overall mood is calm, precise, and data-focused, with a strong editorial sense of hierarchy. Large PolySans headlines feel bold and sculptural, set in tight black type with generous spacing around them, while the supporting Inter text keeps everything readable and functional. The layout is spacious and centered, using clear two-column composition in the hero and disciplined card grids below, with a premium SaaS/AI-dashboard feel rather than decorative flourish.

The palette is mostly white and soft off-white, balanced by charcoal text, pale gray cards, and subtle borders that keep surfaces clean and lightweight. Sunset orange appears sparingly as a highlight in charts, icons, and small emphasis points, giving the interface a controlled warmth without overpowering the neutral structure. Cards are flat and understated, with rounded corners, ghost-style buttons, and thin outlined controls that reinforce the sense of precision. The product screenshots and dashboard previews are the visual anchors: they’re clean, minimal, and analytical, often featuring delicate line charts, metric tiles, and soft shadows or none at all. Overall it feels polished, restrained, modern, and quietly confident, with a strong emphasis on clarity and information density handled gracefully."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"V–A–C Sreda","url":"https://sreda.v-a-c.org","uuid":"410ad35a-e85a-4c77-a29a-b3598f804f5c","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/sreda.v-a-c.org/410ad35a-e85a-4c77-a29a-b3598f804f5c/preview_0.jpg","description":"A stark, architectural media-style interface with a highly graphic black-and-white identity. The composition feels like a technical diagram or editorial system rather than a conventional content site: oversized serif-like display letters anchor the top edge, thin horizontal rules stretch across the canvas, and dotted connector lines create a sense of movement and spatial mapping. The layout is airy and deliberate, with lots of white space balancing dense blocks of small text. Typography is the main visual language, ranging from monumental single-letter headlines to compact, highly readable body copy, all set in crisp black on white. Navigation is integrated into the composition as text links with directional arrows and dotted pathways, giving the page a measured, almost schematic rhythm. The overall mood is minimal, intellectual, and precise, with a refined print-editorial sensibility and a distinctly contemporary art-institution feel."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"EVOKE","url":"https://studioevoke.co.uk","uuid":"1e802d79-598e-4745-aaa5-fa66c16608ad","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/studioevoke.co.uk/1e802d79-598e-4745-aaa5-fa66c16608ad/preview_0.jpg","description":"A bold, poster-like design system with a bright light theme and striking billboard clarity. The visual identity is built around oversized black typography on white or saturated flat-color panels, creating immediate contrast and strong brand presence. Layout feels grid-based and full-bleed, with content presented in clean, contained blocks that breathe generously while still feeling compact and impactful. The imagery mix is eclectic and expressive: square lifestyle photography sits alongside playful, colorful flat illustrations and graphic character art, giving the interface an editorial, art-directed feel. Surfaces are crisp and rectangular, with sharp edges, minimal borders, and no soft rounding, which reinforces the graphic, contemporary tone. The typography is heavy, condensed, and assertive, used at large scale like signage or exhibition posters, while smaller details stay restrained and monochrome. Overall, the look is vibrant, curated, and high-contrast, with a design-forward, portfolio-style aesthetic that feels energetic, confident, and visually declarative."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Medium","url":"https://medium.com","uuid":"4784cf2e-58ed-4b0c-8e6d-8758f595d997","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/medium.com/4784cf2e-58ed-4b0c-8e6d-8758f595d997/preview_0.jpg","description":"A warm, editorial landing page with a calm literary-cafe mood. The whole interface sits on a soft vellum/off-white canvas, giving it a paper-like, printed feel rather than a glossy digital one. Visual hierarchy is extremely strong and minimal: a slim top navigation bar, a large centered-left serif hero headline, a short supporting line, and a single pill-shaped dark CTA. The typography is the defining feature — a high-contrast, elegant serif for the main message paired with a restrained sans-serif for navigation and small text, creating a refined magazine or literary journal aesthetic. Spacing is generous and breathable, with lots of open negative space that makes the page feel quiet and deliberate. The palette is tightly controlled: charcoal and inky blacks for text and actions, muted gray for secondary links, and a vivid story-green used sparingly in the illustration cluster on the right. Those illustrations feel hand-drawn, conceptual, and lightly whimsical, mixing organic shapes with geometric diagram lines and a tactile pen-sketch quality. Buttons are small, rounded, and solid black with white text, reinforcing the understated, premium tone. Overall, it feels classic, intelligent, and content-first — polished but organic, with a subtle print-editorial charm."},{"platform":"desktop","title":"Adcker","url":"https://adcker.com","uuid":"2fbe6cdf-c809-4584-b934-5548c2b8c5d6","preview_url":"https://images.refero.design/styles/adcker.com/2fbe6cdf-c809-4584-b934-5548c2b8c5d6/preview_0.jpg","description":"A stark, typographically driven editorial landing page with a monolithic, fashion-magazine sensibility. The interface uses a warm off-white canvas paired with dense black lettering, creating an extreme high-contrast look that feels bold, cerebral, and uncompromising. The hero is dominated by oversized display typography in tight tracking and heavy weights, stacked in a centered composition that feels almost poster-like.
